AUTHNOTT.name: Permits authorized, not started
AUTHNOTT.read: A swelling backlog means builders hold entitlements and are choosing not to break ground.
AUTHNOTT.title: New Privately-Owned Housing Units Authorized but Not Started: Total Units

PERMIT.name: Building permits, total
PERMIT.read: The front of the construction pipeline. Turns before starts by one to two quarters.
PERMIT.title: New Privately-Owned Housing Units Authorized in Permit-Issuing Places: Total Units

PERMIT1.name: Single-family permits
PERMIT1.read: Cleaner than the total, which multifamily swings distort.
PERMIT1.title: New Privately-Owned Housing Units Authorized in Permit-Issuing Places: Single-Family Units

HOUST1F.name: Single-family housing starts
HOUST1F.read: Where permits become dirt. Compare against permits to see the conversion rate.
HOUST1F.title: New Privately-Owned Housing Units Started: Single-Family Units

HOUST.name: Housing starts, total
HOUST.read: Total starts including multifamily, which swings hard on a few large projects.
HOUST.title: New Privately-Owned Housing Units Started: Total Units

MORTGAGE30US.name: 30-year fixed mortgage rate
MORTGAGE30US.read: The affordability lever. Direction and speed matter more than the level.
MORTGAGE30US.title: 30-Year Fixed Rate Mortgage Average in the United States

DGS10.name: 10-year Treasury
DGS10.read: The base the mortgage rate prices off. Watch the gap between the two.
DGS10.title: Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 10-Year Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis

UMCSENT.name: Consumer sentiment
UMCSENT.read: Headline sentiment is a weak housing signal on its own, but it turns early.
UMCSENT.title: University of Michigan: Consumer Sentiment

TDSP.name: Household debt service ratio
TDSP.read: How stretched household budgets already are before a payment shock.
TDSP.title: Household Debt Service Payments as a Percent of Disposable Personal Income

HSN1F.name: New home sales
HSN1F.read: Recorded at contract signing, so slightly ahead of existing sales.
HSN1F.title: New One Family Houses Sold: United States

MSACSR.name: Months supply, new homes
MSACSR.read: Above roughly six months has historically preceded builder discounting.
MSACSR.title: Monthly Supply of New Houses in the United States

EXHOSLUSM495S.name: Existing home sales
EXHOSLUSM495S.read: Records at closing, so it reflects decisions made a month or two earlier.
EXHOSLUSM495S.title: Existing Home Sales

COMPUTSA.name: Housing completions
COMPUTSA.read: Supply arriving now from starts twelve to eighteen months ago.
COMPUTSA.title: New Privately-Owned Housing Units Completed: Total Units

MSPUS.name: Median sales price, US homes
MSPUS.read: Mix-sensitive. A falling median can mean cheaper homes selling, not falling values.
MSPUS.title: Median Sales Price of New Houses Sold for the United States

CSUSHPINSA.name: Case-Shiller national
CSUSHPINSA.read: Two-month lag on a three-month moving average, so it confirms very late.
CSUSHPINSA.title: S&P Cotality Case-Shiller U.S. National Home Price Index
CSUSHPINSA.release_name: S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Indices

WPUSI012011.name: Construction materials PPI
WPUSI012011.read: Reaches pro formas before it reaches completed cost.
WPUSI012011.title: Producer Price Index by Commodity: Special Indexes: Construction Materials

JTS2300JOL.name: Construction job openings
JTS2300JOL.read: Hiring intent turns before payrolls. Better labor read than employment level.
JTS2300JOL.title: Job Openings: Construction
JTS2300JOL.release_name: Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey

USCONS.name: Construction employment
USCONS.read: Coincident. Useful mainly as a check on the openings series.
USCONS.title: All Employees, Construction

PRRESCONS.name: Residential construction spend
PRRESCONS.read: Put-in-place dollars, so it reflects work already underway.
PRRESCONS.title: Total Private Construction Spending: Residential in the United States

DRSFRMACBS.name: SF mortgage delinquency
DRSFRMACBS.read: Lags badly but confirms turns. Watch the rate of change, not the level.
DRSFRMACBS.title: Delinquency Rate on Single-Family Residential Mortgages, Booked in Domestic Offices, All Commercial Banks
DRSFRMACBS.release_name: Charge-Off and Delinquency Rates on Loans and Leases at Commercial Banks

DRCRELEXFACBS.name: CRE loan delinquency
DRCRELEXFACBS.read: Multifamily is the segment to watch given the completion wave working through.
DRCRELEXFACBS.title: Delinquency Rate on Commercial Real Estate Loans (Excluding Farmland), Booked in Domestic Offices, All Commercial Banks
DRCRELEXFACBS.release_name: Charge-Off and Delinquency Rates on Loans and Leases at Commercial Banks

CABPPRIV.name: California permits authorized
CABPPRIV.read: State pipeline. Compare against national permits to see if California is diverging.
CABPPRIV.title: New Private Housing Units Authorized by Building Permits for California
CABPPRIV.release_name: Housing Units Authorized By Building Permits

CASTHPI.name: California house price index
CASTHPI.read: FHFA all-transactions, quarterly. Slow but consistent.
CASTHPI.title: All-Transactions House Price Index for California

LXXRSA.name: Los Angeles Case-Shiller
LXXRSA.read: Your metro, same two-month lag as the national index.
LXXRSA.title: S&P Cotality Case-Shiller CA-Los Angeles Home Price Index
LXXRSA.release_name: S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Indices

CAUR.name: California unemployment
CAUR.read: Context for absorption. Rising unemployment shrinks the buyer pool before price moves.
CAUR.title: Unemployment Rate in California
